title: Claude Opus 4.8 Dynamic Workflows Explained
description:
Claude Opus 4.8 Dynamic Workflows adds a new way for Claude Code to handle multi-step coding tasks. Use /fast in Claude Code to run Fast Mode, the same model at roughly 2.5x speed and three times cheaper than before. The video covers planning tasks, executing step by step, and checking the output inside a workflow. This Claude Code Fast Mode update is useful for AI agents and coding workflows.
#ssktechy
